entries.purpose.title: Murakaza neza kuri Rinda
entries.purpose.body: Rinda igufasha kumenya imyitwarire ya buri munsi igira ingaruka ku buzima bwawe. Ni iy'inyigisho, si isuzuma rya muganga, kandi si serivisi y'ubutabazi bwihuse. Ushobora gusimbuka ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose.
entries.neutral.title: Ushobora gufunga iyi paji.
